title: Project Orrery opt-in Team metadata contracts

team_config.description: Git-private, explicit local enablement; absent means Personal zero-network.

metadata_envelope.description: Strict 64 KiB maximum projection of existing Member/Host/Workstream/Git/Scope/finding/validation/review facts.

read_only_projection.description: Member then Workstream aggregation; Host remains locator metadata and execution_capability is false.

action_request.description: Central request only; acceptance/rejection requires a Git-private Host-local receipt and execution_performed is false.

manual_invite.description: Project-fingerprint-bound, expiring manual endpoint fallback with a one-use join secret.

host_discovery.description: Untrusted <=1 KiB hint containing only protocol version, opaque project/host/device hints, endpoint, nonce and expiry. It never grants membership.

coordinator_host_switch.description: Manual, expiring single-active Coordinator Host generation transfer; old Hosts retire and automatic election is false.
